title: Parallelisation of Discrete Exterior Calculus via Representation Theory on Curved and Three-Dimensional Meshes
summary: We establish a universal block-diagonalization framework for Discrete Exterior Calculus (DEC) operators on symmetric meshes, enabling embarrassingly parallel solvers with provable FLOP reductions. We prove that the two fundamental DEC operators, the discrete exterior derivative $d$ and the Hodge star $\star$, are equivariant under isometric finite group actions on simplicial complexes.
